This interactive dashboard presents data on violent events recorded by [ACLED](https://acleddata.com/) across Latin America and the Caribbean. The dashboard was developed by me as part of a project for the [UNODC Centre of Excellence for Statistical Information on Government, Crime, Victimization and Justice](https://www.cdeunodc.inegi.org.mx/unodc/index.htm).
